description:
## 2.0.0 (2026-10-31)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **ticktick:** remove local lists and backups

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nikkei:** badge the account subscribe row and disable the paywall overlay e4be15a
* **nikkei:** disable the app's self-updating web bundle 812fb19

### ✨ New Features

* **lrb:** add premium reading patch for 4.6.0 a52fc0f
* **nikkei:** add Nikkei Asia premium reading patch 4f78d8d
* **ticktick:** remove local lists and backups 9b80437

patches.name: HBR extended free reading
patches.description: Raises the free-article meter to 1500 per 30-day window for signed-out and signed-in readers, effectively unlimited within a month, and hides the recurring free-views banner so reading stays clean. Does not grant a subscription, unlock subscriber-only content or change server-run entitlements.

patches.name: Emby client unlock
patches.description: Enables local in-app feature gates using Kirlif's observed approach. Does not grant server Premiere entitlements.

patches.name: Emby remove Firebase and DataTransport
patches.description: Removes Firebase/DataTransport SDK classes and manifest components. Disables Firebase push messaging; keeps Cast and billing libraries.

patches.name: Nikkei Asia premium reading
patches.description: Grants article access in the Nikkei Asia reader by making its local article-access check always succeed, removes the paywall overlay, stops the app's self-updating web bundle from replacing the patched assets, labels the Account screen "Premium Unlocked by BadFella" and its Subscribe row "Patched by BadFella". Keeps account sign-in and store billing; does not change server-side entitlements.

patches.name: Pep Talk Elite features
patches.description: Enables local Elite features, labels the profile status and silences unavailable-purchase warnings from background product lookup. Keeps authentication and purchase handling; does not grant server-side access or a subscription.

patches.name: MIT Tech Review reading meter
patches.description: Removes local article gates and the remaining-views banner, and enables the app's ad-free flag for native and article ads. Keeps account authentication; does not grant a server subscription.

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.

patches.name: Restore notifications
patches.description: Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.

patches.name: Restore reminder alarms
patches.description: Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.

patches.name: TickTick Premium
patches.description: Enables client-side premium features and limits. Does not grant server-side AI access or a subscription.

patches.name: Wanderlog Pro features
patches.description: Enables local Pro feature checks, removes subscription prompts and auto-opening paywalls, hides the home Pro star, labels the profile button Pro Activated and brands the billing screen. Keeps the patched bundle in place by disabling Expo OTA updates. Does not grant server-run AI, downloads, flight tracking or a subscription.

patches.name: Remote ATV ad-free
patches.description: Disables advertising, restores startup and replaces premium activation with a local ad-free status. Removes the home banner and its spacing. Does not create a server subscription.

patches.name: LRB premium reading
patches.description: Unlocks locally paywalled LRB articles and issues by making the standard paywall manager report content as unlocked, and brands the settings version banner Patched by BadFella. Keeps account authentication and store billing; does not grant a server subscription.
